integrity: Analytical proof and independently constructed expected-count diagnostics; no field calibration or independent verification. Priority remains provisional given inaccessible Etterson 2013 full text and possible older inspection-design formulations.
scientific_limitations: Constant mean fatality intensity; exponential scavenging; fixed independent detection probability at each instantaneous, potentially coincident visit; discovery-count objective rather than estimator accuracy; no temporal adaptation or visit overhead. Exact optimum proven within this model only.
title: A sharp separation threshold and endpoint-offset law for carcass-search calendars
